Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self,value,left=None,right=None): self.value,self.left,self.right=value,left,right

def is_bst(root, low=float("-inf"), high=float("inf")):
    if root is None: return True
    if not low < root.value < high: return False
    return is_bst(root.left, low, root.value) and is_bst(root.right, root.value, high)

root=TreeNode(5,TreeNode(3),TreeNode(8))
assert is_bst(root)
root.right.left=TreeNode(4)
assert not is_bst(root)
```
explanation: Propagate strict lower and upper bounds, not just parent-child comparisons. O(n) time and O(h) recursion space.
